# Uptimizr

> Open-source (Apache-2.0), privacy-first, self-hosted analytics for 3D scenes. Captures what
> visitors look at, click, walk past and miss inside a WebGL/WebGPU/WebXR scene — view-direction and
> click heatmaps, mesh interaction, navigation, performance and session replay — and exposes all of
> it to AI agents through a generated, semantically described read API.

This is the marketing site. The documentation, and the machine-readable versions of it, live under
`/docs`.

## Documentation

- [Docs index for LLMs](https://uptimizr.com/docs/llms.txt): the entry point — links to the
  abridged and complete documentation sets.
- [Abridged documentation](https://uptimizr.com/docs/llms-small.txt): the whole docs site with
  non-essential content removed.
- [Complete documentation](https://uptimizr.com/docs/llms-full.txt): every docs page, inlined.
- [Docs site](https://uptimizr.com/docs/): the human-readable version.
- [Building agents on Uptimizr](https://uptimizr.com/docs/guides/agents/): the AI-first layer end to
  end — metric registry, discovery, MCP, result formats, scoped keys, evaluation.

## Querying an Uptimizr deployment

There is no Uptimizr-operated API: every deployment is the operator's own collector, so the base URL
is theirs. Against any collector:

- `GET {collector}/api/v1/openapi.json` — an OpenAPI 3.1 description of the whole read API,
  generated from the semantic metric registry. No API key required; it contains no project data.
  Each operation carries the metric's grain, units, limits, caveats and interpretation as
  `x-uptimizr-*` vendor extensions.
- `GET {collector}/api/v1/whoami` — what the calling API key is permitted to do.
- Read endpoints authenticate with an `x-api-key` header holding the `query` capability, and accept
  `format=full | table | summary`. **Prefer `format=summary`**: a bounded digest with shares, the
  metric's caveats and a templated reading sentence, instead of a thousand raw rows.

## MCP

- [`@uptimizr/mcp`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@uptimizr/mcp): a read-only Model Context Protocol
  server over a collector's query API, run over stdio with
  `UPTIMIZR_COLLECTOR_URL` + `UPTIMIZR_API_KEY`. One tool per served metric, plus the
  `uptimizr://capabilities` and `uptimizr://scenes` resources and three analysis prompts. No
  ingestion, mutation or raw per-session tools; nothing leaves the operator's infrastructure.

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/RaananW/Uptimizr): source, architecture decision records,
  and the full SDK/API integration reference.
